notes.title: Patch #004
notes.content: - Ammo System Optimization: Players now start each level with the exact amount of ammo suited to it. There is no longer a need to pick up ammo or reload at the beginning of a match.

notes.title: Patch #002
notes.content:
- Improved tutorial to better explain gameplay mechanics
- Significant reduction in the number of mines in levels to reduce player frustration

notes.title: Patch #0001
notes.content:
- Fixed missing debris during explosions
- Fixed default sound volume set to 0 instead of 100

notes.title: Check&Clean is available NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=SgAy-Pcj0cY;full][/previewyoutube]
Check&Clean is a tactical First Person Shooter blending music, speedrun elements and intense action. It immerses you in a rhythmic universe, alternating analysis sequences and gunfights. The innovative music coordination allows players to synchronize explosive moments with beats. 

You will have multiple tools to escape your robbery nightmare: Weapons, C4, cameras, ammunition boxes and mines. Take care of analyzing different rooms before entering in. Informations are crucial in our game. You will not survive if you enter a room without analyzing environment first.

« Every night, I have the same nightmare. I’m pulling a heist. Stuck in a room, there is only one exit : a locked door. It can be a hotel, an office, a basement, or a laboratory. But everytime, it begins the same way… I choose a weapon. »

MUSIC
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841479/da33828789b481265c5f7e24b5c1493d08be8f8b.png
The innovative music coordination allows players to synchronize explosive moments with beats.

WEAPONS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841479/dbd5148872a5691807b3b94644dc78d7a908eddd.gif

There are several weapons you can unlock by completing levels. Each weapon can be customized and adapted to your style with unlockable In-Game attachments.

CAMERAS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841479/c00bbe6640384255938d2ffefa2ce6247b2b3eaf.png

In each level, there are 5 cameras giving you perspective to 5 different rooms. Cameras allow you to anticipate enemies position, ammo boxes position, and mines position. CHECK !

C4
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841479/7f5fbb65a8ef8b1813e2d655a0c82249666ef6b0.gif

Use C4 to destroy doors and clean areas. Pay attention to know all the details hidden behind the door before destroying it. CLEAN !

AMMUNITION BOX
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841479/86649f462c68ee211f85e1dca2ab8b78d868837b.png

Different ammunition boxes are concealed in the rooms. You won’t survive without finding them.

MINES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841479/3318d71a298f22893deaecf8e35f8072d7f1bae1.gif

Several mines are hidden in the rooms. Be extremely vigilant, and use them to your advantage.

RANDOMIZATION
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841479/424ed15a4a9366b56d8c3499361706272c1f0b5e.gif

Check&Clean also claims to be a memory game. There are several randomization systems to force the player to analyze their environment and optimize the replayability experience. Randomization affects enemy positions, ammunition boxes position, and mines position.
